description_en: Creates a session based on the session management feature by calling StartTerminalSession. You can establish a WebSocket session with an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance by specifying the instance ID, and remotely connect to the instance by using the WebSocket URL returned in the response
description_zh: 调用StartTerminalSession基于会话管理功能创建一个会话。您可以通过指定ECS实例ID与该实例建立一个WebSocket会话，通过接口返回的WebSocketUrl可以远程连接到ECS实例
name: StartTerminalSession

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the latest regions
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The port number of the ECS instance used for port forwarding. If you specify this parameter, the Cloud Assistant Agent forwards data to the specified port. For example, SSH uses port 22.

Default value: empty, which indicates that no port number is specified for port forwarding
parameters.help_zh:
指定ECS实例的端口号，用于数据转发。一旦设置该参数，云助手Agent的数据转发会传到指定的端口号，用于端口转发。例如，SSH使用22端口。

默认值为空，表示不设置数据转发的端口号
parameters.name: port_number

parameters.help_en:
The command to execute after the session is initiated. The value cannot exceed 512 characters in length.

If you specify `CommandLine`, you cannot specify `PortNumber` or `TargetServer`
parameters.help_zh:
发起会话后，指定执行的命令内容。长度不能超过512个字符。

指定了`CommandLine`后，不能再指定`PortNumber`和`TargetServer`
parameters.name: command_line

parameters.help_en:
The address of the destination service in the VPC that is accessed through the instance.

If this parameter is not empty, `PortNumber` specifies the port number of the destination service in the VPC accessed through the managed instance
parameters.help_zh:
指定通过实例访问VPC内目标服务地址。

当该参数不为空时，`PortNumber`表示通过托管实例访问VPC内目标服务的端口号
parameters.name: target_server

parameters.help_en: The username used to connect to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 指定连接时的用户名称
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the WebSocket URL required for remotely connecting to the instance. Valid values:
Internet: the Internet (default).
Intranet: the internal network
parameters.help_zh:
远程连接实例所需WebSocket URL的网络类型。
Internet：公网（默认）
Intranet：内网
parameters.name: connection_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the user password used when using Session Manager on a Windows instance. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length.
If you want to use Session Manager on a Windows instance as a non-default user (other than System), you must specify both `Username` and this parameter. To reduce the risk of password leakage, the plaintext password must be hosted in the parameter repository of CloudOps Orchestration Service, and you only need to pass the password name here. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186828.html
parameters.help_zh:
在 Windows 实例中使用Session Manager时用户的密码名称。长度不得超过 255 个字符。
当您希望以非默认用户（System）在 Windows 实例中使用Session Manager时，需要同时传入Username和该参数。为降低密码泄露的风险，需要将密码明文托管在系统运维管理的参数仓库中，此处仅传入密码的名称。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186828.html
parameters.name: password_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable end-to-end encryption for the session connection
fields.help_zh: 开启会话连接端到端加密
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en:
The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key.
Precautions:
Only KMS symmetric keys are supported.
You can specify this parameter only when the encryption mode is set to Kms
fields.help_zh:
KMS秘钥ID。
注意事项：
仅支持KMS对称密钥。
仅当加密模式为Kms时，支持指定该参数
fields.name: kms_key_id

fields.help_en:
The encryption mode. Valid values:
Auto: uses automatically negotiated keys to encrypt the session.
Kms: uses KMS keys to encrypt the session.
Default value: Auto.

Precautions:
You can specify this parameter only when session encryption is enabled
fields.help_zh:
加密模式。可选值：
Auto：使用自动协商密钥加密会话。
Kms：使用KMS密钥加密会话。
默认值：Auto。

注意事项：
仅当开启会话加密时，支持指定该参数
fields.name: mode

SecurityToken.description_en: The security token appended to the WebSocket request header, which is used by the system to verify the request
SecurityToken.description_zh: 附加在WebSocket的请求头部，用于系统校验本次请求

WebSocketUrl.description_en: The URL corresponding to the WebSocket session for remotely connecting to the ECS instance. It includes the session ID (`SessionId`) and the `SecurityToken` used for system verification
WebSocketUrl.description_zh: 远程连接ECS实例的WebSocket会话对应的URL。包含了会话ID（`SessionId`）以及用于系统校验的`SecurityToken`
